Both word lists are the Core Vocabularies from Dickinson College Commentaries (DCC), ordered by frequency, with definitions shown as published.

Greek: the DCC Greek Core Vocabulary (dcc.dickinson.edu/greek-core-list), about 500 of the most frequent words in ancient Greek. Compiled in 2012–13 by Christopher Francese with Wilfred Major, Eric Casey, Meghan Reedy, Marc Mastrangelo, Alice Ettling, James Martin, Meredith Wilson and Lara Frymark, from frequency data supplied by the Thesaurus Linguae Graecae and the Perseus Project. Retrieved 2026-09-24.

Latin: the DCC Latin Core Vocabulary (dcc.dickinson.edu/latin-vocabulary-list), about 1,000 of the most frequent words in Latin. Retrieved 2026-09-26.
